apo_monomer.symmetry_rule: After the unchanged CA fit, independently choose same or exchanged OE1/OE2 correspondence for each glutamate by minimum squared displacement. This compares carboxylate geometry without imposing equivalence on a specified protonated oxygen; protonation is absent from these models.
apo_monomer.scope: coordinate consistency among author predictions, not a measured conformational distribution, binding cost, or evidence that the active geometry is occupied
